note: RV park run by the Exchange Club of Albany beside its fairgrounds; entrance at 2007 W Oakridge Dr. Gated. The club's own website has no RV-park page, rates or booking. --Claude
summary: No operator page for the RV park: the stored website is NXDOMAIN and the club's current site (exchangeclubofalbany.org, phone 229-436-8827) lists only hall/fairground rentals. Google Maps 'Albany Exchange Club RV Park' (2007 W Oakridge Dr, 4.6 stars from only 8 reviews, phone (229) 395-5802, website exchangeclubofalbany.org) - reviews describe mostly long-term residents on monthly lot rent. No nightly rate anywhere from the operator, no booking engine. Cleared directory-only hookups, site count/length, Wi-Fi and season; note rewritten. No gateway within 40 km (Atlanta 245 km); the family has not stayed here. Fails long-stay test 2 and the presence rule - see flags.
flags: CRITERIA - long-stay test 2 fails (same as Toccoa RV Park, p3-196): no nightly rate is posted by the operator anywhere and there is no booking engine. The club's site exchangeclubofalbany.org has no RV-park page at all (its 'Rental Information' page covers only the conference room, exhibit building, livestock pavilion and open-air building). Google reviews: '6 months ago' (~Apr 2026): 'Lots of full hook up sites. Mostly long term residents.'; 'a year ago' (~late 2025): 'monthly lot rent is very reasonable'. Recommend drop.

CRITERIA - presence rule fails: stored website https://www.exchangeclubofalbany.com/ is NXDOMAIN (dead domain); the club's live site has no RV-park content; Google Maps listing has only 8 reviews (rule needs 25+), phone (229) 395-5802.
Phone: stored 229-436-8827 is the Exchange Club's general helpline; the RV park's Google listing gives (229) 395-5802.

Pin ~700 m off: stored 31.54918,-84.22270 is on the fairground's south field by the highway; the RV rows are in the north-east corner at about 31.5548,-84.2191 (Google's point 31.5541,-84.2200 is the gate road just west of them).

Fair events may close or crowd it: the Southwest Georgia Regional Fair runs on these fairgrounds each late October/early November (2025: Oct 28 - Nov 2); no operator statement on RV-park closures was found.
